Agent Name: Verification_Expert
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: They chose to create and use mock (random) temperature data instead of obtaining accurate historical June 2020–2023 data for Houston, violating the task constraint that the analysis be based on real data. This decision led directly to the reported 35% figure being computed from synthetic values rather than actual records. (They also initially used 31 days in June, later corrected, but the core error was relying on mock data.)
